definitions.explanation: An infectious disease of birds, especially poultry, caused by influenza viruses. Outbreaks on Japanese farms lead to the culling of whole flocks and are reported in the news every winter.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}インフルエンザ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: There was an outbreak of bird flu.

examples.japanese: {養鶏場|ようけいじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鳥|とり}インフルエンザ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Bird flu was confirmed at a poultry farm.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}インフルエンザ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感染拡大|かんせんかくだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{十万羽|じゅうまんわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{殺処分|さっしょぶん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: About 100,000 chickens were culled to stop the spread of bird flu.

notes:
Often shortened to ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧インフル in speech and headlines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥|とり}インフルエンザ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: an outbreak occurs
- {高病原性|こうびょうげんせい}{鳥|とり}インフルエンザ: highly pathogenic avian influenza
- {殺処分|さっしょぶん}: culling (of infected flocks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧: influenza, flu — the human seasonal illness
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦インフルエンザ→インフルエンザ：05384_infuruenza⟧: swine flu
